envelope.description: IndexState: reads, in-transaction count updates, completeness

body.title: IndexState: reads, in-transaction count updates, completeness
body.summary: A module beside the store holds IndexState (sc1 with reasonCounts, AMD-2): readIndexState(repoPath); helpers that move pending counts by class and reason and count unwritables by reason, called only inside an open write transaction; the daemon-wide unattributed counter; the recount on open as a check (a difference corrected and logged at warn; only registered repoIds visited, an unregistered repoId's row deleted); completenessOf(state | undefined) -> RepoCompleteness with one reason line per non-zero cause, awaiting rows split by reason, 'no-candidate' rows not a cause. Anchors: write transactions are lmdb-js root.transaction (withWriteTxn, src/db/graph/store.ts:882-886), which aborts every write when its callback throws; the count helpers run only inside such a callback. Depends on t1 for the index_state sub-DB and its codec. Rule for every count write: the row writes and the count updates of one change go in ONE synchronous callback of withWriteTxn (src/db/graph/store.ts:882) with no await between them, so a throw aborts both.
acceptanceChecks: graphComplete and complete follow the sc1 formula for every combination of the inputs (table test)
completenessOf(undefined) reads not complete with 'a reindex is needed'
A count update inside a transaction that then throws leaves the stored counts unchanged
A hand-edited count is corrected on open with a warn log; an unregistered repoId's row is deleted
A test throws inside a withWriteTxn callback after writing a pending row and its count, and asserts neither is visible afterwards

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/index-state.test.ts: completenessOf table test, undefined state, reason lines, recount on open corrects a hand-edited count, unregistered repoId row deleted, aborted transaction leaves counts
